children: Halliburton elected Maurice S. Smith as Lead Independent Director and will pay a $40,000 additional annual retainer for the role.
Maurice S. Smith was elected Lead Independent Director by independent directors, effective immediately.
Smith will receive an additional $40,000 annual retainer for serving as Lead Independent Director.
The retainer aligns with the company's non-management director compensation program disclosed in the March 31, 2026 proxy.
Robert A. Malone will remain a director; the Board thanked him for his service as former Lead Independent Director.
